interpretations: Consider all invoices, including those with no line items. For each, count its invoice line items and average each line item’s `derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost` ratio. Show a count of 0 and no average for invoices without line items, then return the 10 invoices with the highest line item counts in descending order.
queries:
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count,
    AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost) AS average_cost_ratio
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC
LIMIT 10
